comment: Independent trap.c witness for launch_obj()'s rolling boulder hitting a monster with a passive attack: the debug Archeologist steps east, wishes a rolling boulder trap there, steps back, creates an acid blob beside her and steps onto the trap. The boulder hits the acid blob first; mthrowu.c ohitmon() -> drop_throw() calls uhitm.c passive_obj(), whose AD_ACID arm draws rn2(6) to corrode the boulder. The boulder then kills her, and she declines to die. I chose seed 9940034 from a scan of 9940001-9940119 that read passive_obj() calls from the C RNG log.
